use: Ordered PAD_MUX candidates for ARRIVAL-08/09. Nothing here closes a profile key: J18 pin numbers, the header I/O voltage and the pad owner are measured on the board, and only a reviewed commit with the ARRIVAL-09/11 records changes the profile.

sources.title: UM12340 FRDM-IMX8MPLUS Board User Manual, Rev. 1.0, 24 June 2025
sources.finding: J18 is a 2x20-pin GPIO expansion connector for I2S, UART, I2C and GPIO, compatible with the 8MIC-RPI-MX8 card. The manual has no J18 pin table.

sources.title: imx8mp-frdm.dts, nxp-imx/linux-imx branch lf-6.12.y
sources.finding: pwm1-pwm4 are enabled with no consumer; ecspi2 has only a spidev; uart3 uses the ECSPI1 pads; micfil (PDM) uses the SAI5 pads; SAI3 and I2C3 serve the WM8962 codec; SAI2 serves Bluetooth SCO; two PCAL6416A expanders sit on I2C1 at 0x20 and 0x21.

sources.title: imx8mp-pinfunc.h, torvalds/linux master
sources.finding: The GPIO alternate of every candidate pad below.

sources.title: FRDM-IMX8MPLUS schematic (NXP account required)
needed_for: J18 pin number of each pad
pad bank supply rail and header voltage
level shifters or series parts on each J18 line

exclusions.what: PCAL6416A expander lines (pca6416_a at I2C1 0x20, pca6416_b at I2C1 0x21)
exclusions.why: Not native SoC GPIO; the profile requires gpio1-gpio5 for gpio-keys wake.
Used by the WM8962 headset codec, the FRDM-GATE-AUDIO path.
Used by the Bluetooth SCO audio link.

candidates.reason: Native gpio1 pad whose only default owner is an unused PWM.
Native gpio1 pad whose only default owner is an unused PWM.
Native gpio1 pad whose only default owner is an unused PWM. The Waveshare backlight is an I2C device, not pwm1.
Native gpio3 pad whose only default owner is an unused PWM.

candidates.default_owner: ecspi2 chip select (already GPIO5_IO13, held by the spidev cs-gpios)
candidates.reason: Only if the header SPI is unused; also frees GPIO5_IO10-IO12 (SCLK, MOSI, MISO).
Only if the header UART is unused; also frees GPIO5_IO06-IO08.
Last resort: disabling micfil removes the 8MIC-RPI-MX8 PDM path. The project microphone uses the headset codec instead.

arrival_procedure: ARRIVAL-08: find the candidate's J18 pin in the schematic and measure its voltage to GND.
ARRIVAL-09: frdm_j18_gpio_inventory.sh --candidate J18-<pin>:<pad_mux> with that reading; pad_mux_owner must match default_owner or report it free.
Use the highest-ranked candidate that is on J18, reads 3.3 V and passes ARRIVAL-09; set PIR_PAD_OWNER_TO_DISABLE from its pad_owner_to_disable.
